# kranti-hackathon

A small program that reads JSON lines on stdin and writes JSON lines on stdout.

- Plain JavaScript (ES modules), no dependencies. Runtime: Bun 1.4.4 (pinned in the `Dockerfile`).
- Entry point: `bot.js`.

## Build

```sh
docker build -t bot .
```

## Libraries, earlier code, licence

- No third-party libraries and no code written before the event.
- Built with AI assistance (Claude Code); all code in this repository is original to its author.
